run_ytvis_evaluation: run the YT-VIS evaluation script to evaluate segmentation results against ground truth annotations
run_ytvis_evaluation_with_custom_paths: run the YT-VIS evaluation with custom dataset path, dataset name, and result path arguments
summarize_cocoeval_stats: summarize the cocoEval stats into a comma-separated string of percentage values
create_ytvis_parser: create an argparse parser with dataset-path, dataset-name, and result-path arguments for YT-VIS evaluation
evaluate_ytvis_segmentation_results: evaluate YT-VIS segmentation results by loading ground truth and inference results then running evaluation
